[[File:Monotropa_Triflora.png|thumb|right|150px|Monotropa Triflora]]
'''Monotropa Triflora''' was an extremely rare [[Parasite/Legends|parasitic]] [[Plant/Legends|plant]] capable of growing in total darkness on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]]. Often mistaken for a [[Fungus/Legends|fungus]], Monotropa Triflora possessed root systems that intertwined with nearby [[Tree/Legends|trees]] and fungus and thus allowed the plant to [[Diet/Legends|feed]] off other plants' [[Foodstuff/Legends|nutrients]] as well as occasionally absorb properties of other plants. One variety contained a powerful opiate-like property potent enough to numb skin on contact.
